title: 第127章 这一刀，写入史册的帅！！！

content_zh: 使团中。秦钰看着往回走的唐逸，眉头不由皱了起来。不应该啊！从这家伙刚才的手段和心机来看，他不会看不懂炎文帝的用意吧？炎文帝明显是让他拖延时间，但这家伙却是在激化矛盾，这什么意思？秦钰看不懂了，但她总觉得……有阴谋。要是唐逸就是唐逸，那眼前这一幕无可厚非，但唐逸还是小诗仙，足智多谋的小诗仙，不该有这样愚蠢的行为。他，到底要干嘛？相比于多愁善感的秦钰，宇文封看着这一幕脸上就只剩下嘲讽和不屑了。他是知道真相的，这一切袭击沈园杀皇帝劫持百官发大财，就是他北狄和暗京楼联手搞的一出好戏。暗京楼为了杀炎文帝，可是动用了半个暗京楼的杀手。也就是说，站在唐逸前方的，都是暗京楼高手中的高手。但唐逸这蠢货，竟然敢站在他们面前，说一刀解决他们？哈哈，可笑至极！“愚蠢。”宇文封冷笑，忽然觉得暗京楼打岔是好事了。这种蠢货，还没有资格死在他的箭下。“好，好，就是这样，杀了他，杀了他！”颜霜玉和姜云娜攥紧拳头，在心头怒吼。而暗京楼这边，龙斩和暗京楼一众高手看着桥对面，已经开始乱了阵脚的大炎百官和世家大族，也都笑了起来。“小诗仙，这一刀，的确非常帅……”龙斩看着唐逸的背影，手缓缓抬了起来：“你这一刀，成功瓦解了大炎的抵抗之心，导致他们开始内乱。”“让我们的屠杀，更加的轻松简单。”“你，替我暗京楼，立了大功了。”“放心，等下杀你的时候……我一定会很不客气的。”龙斩的声音刚落，身后的暗京楼高手也都大笑起来，笑声猖狂嗜血。同时，所有人都提起武器，狩猎开始了。只要龙斩手挥下，他们便全面出击，杀得大炎皇帝和文武百官血流成河。这可是他们暗京楼最具有历史意义的时刻，自然要好好的蓄力来纪念这一刻，因为这一刻他们出手就意味着——大炎，亡了！然而，面对所有人的愤怒和嘲讽，桥上的少年却只是随意挥了挥手。“不急，让刀气先飞一会儿。”声音平静而淡定。“哈哈哈……”听到他的话，暗京楼一众笑声震天。“刀气，小子，你知道什么叫刀气吗？”“那是一流高手才练出来的东西，但你现在连九流高手都算不上，还刀气？哈哈……”“就你那一刀，鸡都杀不死……”“……”暗京楼一众杀手都在狞笑，唯独龙斩瞳孔陡缩，心头升起浓浓的不安。因为原本脚步从容的唐逸，此时竟然加快步伐，下一秒就是百米冲刺的速度下了桥。难不成这家伙真有阴谋？来不及多想，龙斩抬起的手迅速挥下：“给我杀，一个不留……”然而。他话音刚落。轰！轰隆！雷霆般的轰鸣声忽然炸响天地！怎么回事？！龙斩惊恐间，猛地转过头，便看到他此生难忘的景象。暗京楼大军集结的地方，竟然像是在一瞬间齐齐遭到雷击一般，四面八方都在爆炸。而随着每一簇火光的爆炸，原本嚣张的暗京楼高手，几乎瞬间就被火光撕裂成碎片，手脚肝脏血淋淋掉一地，惨不忍睹……“啊！这什么鬼东西？”“这是雷霆，这是天罚，是老天爷对我们这些年作恶的惩罚。”“救命，我不想死……”“……”惨叫声，哀嚎声，爆炸声汇聚成一片，响彻整片天地。而这时，龙斩已经被扑面而来的气浪掀飞出去，人还在半空，他瞳孔已经充血瞪大，满脸的震惊和难以置信。甚至还有深深的惶恐！他的暗京楼高手，他的那么多的毁天灭地的暗京楼高手，现在正在遭到一面倒的大屠杀。连敌人在哪，敌人是谁都没搞清楚，就被撕碎了。明明，今日展开屠杀的主角应该是他们啊！“啊啊……这怎么回事？这怎么回事？”“唐逸，唐逸恶贼，你做了什么？！”龙斩咆哮。他被气浪直接掀飞出数丈开外，落在地上便一口鲜血喷了出来。然而此时他却顾不得伤势，盯着远处被炸得粉身碎骨的暗京楼高手，眼睛充血，杀气冲天。刀气？我刀气你大爷！这特妈是刀气能打出来的伤害吗？刀气杀人无形，谁特妈的刀气能这么炸的？！大炎阵营这边，原本众人听到唐逸说让刀气飞一会儿，全都怒火中烧，忍不住想要将他抓过来打一顿。刀气？你知道刀气是什么东西吗？但现在，所有人都傻眼了！胆小的人在爆炸声响起的那一刻，已经抱着头吓趴在了地上，甚至有很多人都给吓尿了。而还能站着的人，这时看着河对岸被爆炸吞没死成渣的暗京楼高手，全都瞪大双眼，震惊得张大了嘴巴。这是唐逸干的？这就是唐逸的刀气？你特妈是不是对刀气有误会？谁的刀气能引动雷霆，造成这毁天灭地的威势的？！“我……卧槽！”这一刻，炎文帝呆了，脑瓜子都是嗡嗡的，下意识爆了粗口。原来唐逸这小子没说大话啊！他只是在阐述一个事实。这一刀，的确很帅，帅炸天了啊！“这……这怎么可能？！”刘温，赵轲等一群文官，看着这血腥的一幕双腿都在颤抖，甚至很多大臣都已经跌坐在了地上，全都瞠目结舌。恐惧，从未有过的恐惧，几乎将他们所有人给吞噬了。此时此刻，他们忽然才意识到，那个他们瞧不上的少年，远比他们所想象的可怕得多。同时，所有人都恨不得爬起来，再将唐敬给轮一遍！妈的，这就是你说的废物？你见过哪个废物能引动雷霆的？“这不可能，这怎么可能？”唐敬也是脸色苍白，声音的尖锐了起来。这个他最瞧不上的儿子，再一次刷新了他的认知。他，竟然这么厉害？“草草，威力居然真的这么大？牛逼了！”萧棣也是震惊得跳了起来，看着唐逸的目光那是一个羡慕嫉妒恨。靠哦，这下这家伙装逼装大发了，早知道应该自己上的啊！妈的，这一刀帅！注定是写入史册的帅！！！
content_en: In the mission.Qin Yu looked at Tang Yi walking back and frowned.It shouldn’t be!Judging from this guy's methods and scheming just now, he couldn't understand Emperor Yanwen's intentions, right?Emperor Yanwen was obviously asking him to delay, but this guy was intensifying the conflict. What did this mean?Qin Yu couldn't understand it anymore, but she always felt... there was a conspiracy.If Tang Yi is Tang Yi, then there is nothing wrong with the scene before him, but Tang Yi is still a little poetry fairy, and a resourceful little poetry fairy should not behave like this.What on earth is he going to do?Compared to the sentimental Qin Yu, Yu Wenfeng looked at this scene with only ridicule and disdain on his face.He knew the truth. All this attack on Shen Yuan, killing the emperor, and kidnapping hundreds of officials to make a fortune was a good show that he and Beidi and An Jinglou jointly staged.In order to kill Emperor Yanwen, An Jing Tower used half of An Jing Tower's killers.In other words, those standing in front of Tang Yi are all masters among the masters of Anjing Tower.But this idiot Tang Yi actually dared to stand in front of them and say that he would kill them with one blow?Haha, so ridiculous!"Stupid." Yu Wenfeng sneered, suddenly feeling that An Jinglou's interruption was a good thing.This kind of idiot is not qualified to die under his arrow."Okay, okay, that's it, kill him, kill him!" Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna clenched their fists and roared in their hearts.On the Anjing Tower side, Long Zhan and the experts from the Anjing Tower looked across the bridge at the Great Yan Baiguan and the aristocratic families who had begun to lose their position, and they all laughed."Xiao Shixian, this sword is indeed very handsome..." Long Zhan looked at Tang Yi's back and slowly raised his hand: "With this sword of yours, you successfully broke down Dayan's resistance and caused them to start civil strife." "Let our massacre be even more intense.Easy and simple." "You have done a great job for me An Jing Tower." "Don't worry, I will be very rude when I kill you later." As soon as Long Zhan's voice fell, the masters of An Jing Tower behind him also laughed, their laughter was rampant and bloodthirsty.At the same time, everyone raised their weapons and the hunt began.As long as Long Zhan's hand was waved, they launched a full-scale attack, killing Emperor Yan and all the civil and military officials in a river of blood.This is the most historic moment for their Anjing Tower. Naturally, they have to gather their strength to commemorate this moment, because their action at this moment means - Dayan is dead!However, facing everyone's anger and ridicule, the boy on the bridge just waved his hand casually."Don't worry, let the sword energy fly for a while." The voice was calm and calm."Hahaha..." After hearing his words, everyone in Anjing Tower burst into laughter."Sword Qi, boy, do you know what sword Qi is?" "It is something that only first-class masters can practice, but now you are not even a ninth-rate master, why are you giving back sword Qi? Haha..." "With that knife of yours, even a chicken can't be killed..." "..." All the killers in Anjing Tower were grinning ferociously, but Long Zhan's pupils shrank sharply, and he felt a deep sense of uneasiness in his heart.Because Tang Yi, who was originally walking calmly, actually accelerated his pace at this time, and in the next second he was sprinting off the bridge at a speed of 100 meters.Is it possible that this guy really has a conspiracy?Without any time to think, Long Zhan raised his hand and quickly waved it down: "Kill me, no one will be spared..." However.He just finished speaking.boom!Boom!A thunderous roar suddenly exploded across the world!What's going on?!When Long Zhan was frightened, he suddenly turned his head and saw a sight he would never forget in his life.Where the Anjing Tower army gathered, it was as if they were all struck by lightning in an instant, with explosions happening in all directions.And with the explosion of each burst of fire, the originally arrogant Anjing Tower master was torn into pieces by the fire almost instantly, and his hands, feet, and liver were all bloody on the ground. It was horrific... "Ah! What the hell is this?" "This is thunder, this is heaven's punishment, God's punishment for the evil we have done over the years." "Help, I don't want to die..." "..." Screams, wails, and explosions converged into one, resounding throughout the entire world.At this time, Long Zhan had been thrown away by the air wave that hit his face. He was still in mid-air. His pupils were bloodshot and wide, and his face was full of shock and disbelief.There is even deep fear!His masters from the Anjing Tower, so many of his masters from the Anjing Tower who have destroyed the world, are now being massacred in a one-sided manner.They were torn apart without even knowing where or who the enemy was.Obviously, they should be the protagonists of today's massacre!"Ah...what's going on? What's going on?" "Tang Yi, Tang Yi, evil thief, what have you done?!" Long Zhan roared.He was thrown several feet away by the air wave, and when he landed on the ground, he spurted out a mouthful of blood.However, at this time, he ignored his injuries and stared at the Anjing Tower master who was blown to pieces in the distance, his eyes bloodshot and murderous.Knife energy?I'm mad at you!Is this special damage that the sword energy can inflict?The sword energy can kill people invisible. Who can kill someone with such a sword energy?!In the Dayan camp, everyone was furious when they heard Tang Yi said to let the sword energy fly for a while, and couldn't help but want to catch him and beat him up.Knife energy?Do you know what knife energy is?But now, everyone is dumbfounded!The timid people were lying on the ground holding their heads in fear the moment the explosion sounded. Many people were even scared to the point of peeing.As for those who were still standing, their eyes widened and their mouths opened in shock as they looked at the Anjinglou masters on the other side of the river who were swallowed up and turned to pieces by the explosion.Was this done by Tang Yi?Is this Tang Yi's sword energy?Does your mother have a misunderstanding about sword energy?Whose sword energy can trigger thunder and create such a powerful force that destroys the world?!"I...fuck you!" At this moment, Emperor Yan Wen was stunned, his head was buzzing, and he subconsciously cursed.It turns out that this guy Tang Yi didn’t lie!He was simply stating a fact.This sword is indeed very handsome, so handsome!"This...how is this possible?!" Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and a group of civil servants, their legs were shaking when they saw this bloody scene. Many ministers even fell to the ground, all dumbfounded.Fear, unprecedented fear, almost consumed them all.At this moment, they suddenly realized that the young man they despised was far more terrifying than they had imagined.At the same time, everyone was eager to get up and give Tang Jing another round!Damn, is this the trash you're talking about?Have you seen any trash that can trigger thunder?"This is impossible, how is this possible?" Tang Jing also turned pale and his voice became sharp.The son he despised the most once again refreshed his understanding.He is so powerful?"
title_en: Chapter 127 This sword will be recorded in the annals of history!!!
